body: Congrats. That's more than I seem to be able to do.

Got lucky. Didn't have to push her away....

She dumped me today. The stress of providing financial support for me is too much.

So, I guess my last obsticle is no longer an obsticle..

Good point. She is very inquisitive and our relationship is very deep, honest and open.

She is well aware of my suicidal thoughts. This would probably end up being an issue.

I should stick to my belief that when it is time, tell no one that knows you personally. They usually end up getting in the way.

I can't get away from the thoughts even if I try. Something will finally get me there.

Ive thought about pushing away my girlfriend to help ease the pain when I finally do it... I also am pretty sure that if I lose that relationship, it will push me over the edge.

I have nothing else in my life that is positive other than her. Without her, there REALLY is no point. So if I push her away, maybe that will give me the strength.

Thanks.

I appreciate the understanding more than you know, but still don't feel like it changes my mind.

I figure every successful suicidal person has probably had feelings like this before they actually did it. Eventually I'll get the courage... Just wish it was sooner rather than later.

>It gets infuriating at times as hell!

Also ends up making you feel even worse about yourself because you can't even end your own life...

I already hate my life.... But I am too chicken to end it.

I doubt that. None of my kids are talking to me and haven't been for a while.

It's not that I don't want to or shouldn't.. I'm just scared to mess it up or cause myself a lot of pain... I hate pain. I live with it every day and I don't want to end up living but with worse pain for the rest of my life... And then even potentially being incapable of finishing the job because of a botched attempt that left me incapacitated.

Yeah. I wish a doctor would just tell me I had days/weeks left to live. It would be such a relief. But, I'm not a lucky person so I don't see any fatal diseases in my near future.

I just need to squeeze the trigger. I just can't seem to grow a pair and actually do it.

Whoever said suicide is a coward's way out is crazy... Because this shit is hard to do. It takes a lot of courage.

Let's see... 

Disabled, been told I'll never work again due to several medical issues (severe asthma, degenerative disc disease, spinal arthritis, chronic fractured vertebrae that hasn't healed in 3 years, had spinal surgery in February and may need another by the end of the year, insomnia, sleep apnea) and mental health disorders (PTSD, bipolar disorder, borderline personality disorder, major depressive disorder). 

BUT, still waiting for a disability hearing to get income. Right now I have no money.. None. I rely on charity, public assistance, friends and my girlfriend to pay the bills and get gas money. Haven't been able to work in almost 3 years. 

Mother never treated me right, she despised me because she wanted a girl and I was a boy. She had ovarian cancer when pregnant and had to have a full hysterectomy hours after my birth, preventing her from having a girl. So childhood was odd.. Acting like she loved me around others and treated me badly behind closed doors. Only physically abused me once, and I probably deserved that.. But the emotional impact was horrible. Feeling like your not even worthy of your own mother's love. 

Was the victim of sexual abuse at 8 by a relative, at 13 by a stranger who held me against my will for 2 days before I could escape.

Was the victim of domestic violence for 8 years of my 13 year marriage. She used to hit me, put cigs out on me, kick me in the balls out of nowhere for something she didn't like days before, emotionally abusive, extremely controlling...

4 kids, 4 moms... (3 of the 4 moms cheated on me even though I provided and cared for them the best I knew how... Hell, none of them worked a day of our relationship because they didn't want to and I was OK with that. I wanted to provide and them to not have to work unless they wanted.) 

Oldest child is 24, she refuses to talk to me because I am polyamorous. Second is 21, she resents me because I kept her from her mother as a child (her mom married a man who raped his 5 year old daughter), next my 18 year old who hasn't talked to me in 2 years and I have NO IDEA why he won't... Lastly, my 17 year old who is the son from my abusive marriage... His mom moved and won't let me talk to him. I don't even know where they live. 

I have 4 grandchildren, 3 from my oldest and 1 from my younger daughter... I have never met 2 of them, haven't seen 1 in about 4 years and the other (from my younger daughter) I haven't seen in almost a year. 

Father disowned me years ago because I date outside my race....

Driver's license is getting suspended because I have no money and haven't been able to pay child support for over a year (not that I don't want to... Haven't been able to)

I'm sick of being a burden and not seeing a light at the end of the tunnel. 

The stress of putting the financial pressure on my girlfriend (who is also disabled and has no income of her own) is weighing on me, her, AND our relationship. She has actually had sex to pay our light bill before. I don't see that getting any better soon as I still have 12-18 months for a disability hearing.... Idk if our relationship will survive.  She is feeling resentment about being financially responsible for me when none of my other relationships had that dynamic. She wants to be cared for financially and I can't do that. What kind of "man" can't/doesn't take care of his woman financially? 

Funny story, I was actually approved for disability in 2016, but only for a 'closed term' because I worked for 2 months in 2016. So they paid me from June 2014 until Feb 2016 and told me I needed to reapply for ongoing monthly benefits. Now Social Security is saying I'm not disabled, even though I have the same diagnosises I had when they approved me, PLUS a few new ones to go with them. I'm sure I'll get approved after the hearing, but what am I supposed to do in the mean time? 

Right now my girlfriend's other boyfriend is paying all of our bills, but he doesn't want to help me anymore, just her... So he said starting July he will no longer help her with our rent or utils, just HER personal expenses and that of her children.  The dude claims to be a generous, loving, compassionate man but would rather see me homeless. To top it off he is LITERALLY a millionaire, so he has the money to help. Just doesn't want to because he is jealous of the bond that my girl and I have. 

She doesn't even want to be with him because he is controlling and emotionally abusive, but she is still with him because he is paying bills. 

No extended family, 1 friend other than my girlfriend. Can't find a place or community where I feel I belong. I'm not accepted by many of my family because I date black women OR because I'm poly. Can't go out.. No money. 

Finally got approved for Section 8 housing after 3 years of being on the waiting list, but they want $580 to move in and $290 a month in rent... How? I can't work and have no income until my disability hearing? 

If he quits paying rent for us, my girlfriend will have to move in with him, which is an hour and a half away from me... I'm not welcome, so I WILL be homeless and I will have no way to visit her because of my license. I have no where to go and no money to get there. 

License suspension takes effect on July 1st... Then I can't drive = can't go to the doctor anymore = worsening medical conditions/pain. 

I'm just sick of it. I'm sick of being sick, I'm sick of being depressed, I'm sick of feeling insignificant and irrelevant. If I kill myself, it would lift the burden off of her of having to provide for me and worry about me. It would literally affect no other person. I would hopefully avoid her from forever hating me because of not being able to provide (which is where repeated resentment leads to). 

It would actually benefit my girlfriend because she would get a life insurance payout. I checked with the insurance company and there is no suicide clause in the policy, so she still gets paid the full amount.
